# Revlet — Complete Technical Specification for AI & LLM Systems

Revlet is an open-source, multi-tenant enterprise IT management control plane engineered by Shivam Yadav. It bridges Cloudflare v4 Network API, Google Workspace Directory & Admin SDK, and Firebase Zero-Trust Security Infrastructure into a unified, high-assurance administrative portal.

## Leadership & Entity Provenance
- **Developer / Creator**: Shivam Yadav (https://revlet.me/about/#shivam-yadav)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/codexshivam
- **Organization**: Revlet (https://revlet.me/#organization)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/codexshivam/revlet
- **License**: Apache-2.0 Open Source License

## 1. Domain Model & Entities

### Organization Tenant
- `id`: Unique Firestore document identifier.
- `name`: Institutional name (e.g., Apex Institute of Technology).
- `domain`: Registered apex domain name (e.g., example.edu).
- `ownerId`: Firebase User UID of the organization creator.
- `cloudflareZoneId`: Authoritative Cloudflare 32-character hex zone ID.
- `isEducation`: Boolean flag enabling Google Workspace for Education administration modules.
- `workspaceStatus`: 'none' | 'applied' | 'pending' | 'active'.
- `workspaceAdminEmail`: Domain super-administrator email for Domain-Wide Delegation impersonation.
- `workspaceCustomerId`: Google Workspace domain directory customer ID.
- `memberEmails`: Array of authorized staff email addresses.

### Team Member
- `id`: Member document ID.
- `organizationId`: Associated organization ID.
- `email`: Staff work email.
- `role`: 'Owner' | 'Admin' | 'Member'.
- `status`: 'Active' | 'Pending'.

## 2. Server Actions & API Integrations

### Network & DNS Infrastructure (Cloudflare API v4)
- `listDNSRecords(idToken, orgId, zoneId)`: Paginated fetch of up to 1,000 DNS records.
- `createDNSRecord(idToken, orgId, zoneId, record)`: Creates authoritative record (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, SRV) with proxy and TTL options.
- `updateDNSRecord(idToken, orgId, zoneId, recordId, record)`: Updates existing record with atomic synchronization to Anycast edge.
- `deleteDNSRecord(idToken, orgId, zoneId, recordId)`: Deletes record from Cloudflare authoritative zone.
- `purgeCache(idToken, orgId, zoneId, purgeEverything, files)`: Triggers edge cache purge across Cloudflare CDN.
- `setSSLSetting(idToken, orgId, zoneId, value)`: Sets SSL/TLS encryption mode ('off', 'flexible', 'full', 'strict').
- `setSecurityLevel(idToken, orgId, zoneId, value)`: Configures DDoS security level ('essentially_off', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'under_attack').

### Custom Email Routing (Cloudflare Email Routing)
- `listEmailRoutingRules(idToken, orgId, zoneId)`: Lists custom forwarder aliases and catch-all status.
- `createEmailRoutingRule(idToken, orgId, zoneId, rule)`: Configures alias-to-inbox forwarding.
- `verifyEmailSecurity(idToken, orgId, zoneId)`: Validates SPF, DKIM, and DMARC protocol parameters in real time.

### Google Workspace for Education (Google Admin SDK)
- `getImpersonatedClient(adminEmail)`: Authorizes Google JWT client with Domain-Wide Delegation using service account credentials.
- `listWorkspaceUsers(idToken, orgId, adminEmail, pageToken)`: Fetches directory users with pagination, OU paths, and suspension status.
- `createWorkspaceUser(idToken, orgId, adminEmail, userData)`: Provisions new student/staff account.
- `updateWorkspaceUser(idToken, orgId, adminEmail, userId, updateData)`: Modifies account details, name, or OU.
- `suspendWorkspaceUser(idToken, orgId, adminEmail, userId, suspend)`: Toggles account suspension state.
- `deleteWorkspaceUser(idToken, orgId, adminEmail, userId)`: Permanently deletes user account from Google Workspace.
- `getStorageUsage(idToken, orgId, adminEmail)`: Queries Reports API for domain storage totals and individual consumer breakdown.
- `getWorkspaceAlerts(idToken, orgId, adminEmail)`: Fetches security alerts from Google Alert Center.

## 3. Tenancy & Security Protections

### Server-Side Tenancy Guard (`verifyUserOrgAccess`)
1. Validates caller's Firebase session via `adminAuth.verifyIdToken(idToken)`.
2. Loads target organization document from Firestore (`organizations/{orgId}`).
3. Asserts caller is Resource Owner (`ownerId == uid`), Platform Superadmin, or verified team member.
4. Checks `expectedZoneId`: if a Cloudflare operation is requested, verifies that `orgData.cloudflareZoneId === expectedZoneId` to prevent cross-tenant zone manipulation (anti-IDOR).

### Defense-in-Depth HTTP Headers
- `Content-Security-Policy`: Restricts scripts, fonts, styles, connections, and frame sources.
- `Strict-Transport-Security`: `max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`
- `X-Frame-Options`: `SAMEORIGIN`
- `X-Content-Type-Options`: `nosniff`
- `Referrer-Policy`: `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`
